entities.summary: Mark Borisovich Mitin was a Soviet Marxist–Leninist philosopher, university lecturer and Professor of Philosophy Faculty of Moscow State University. He was interested primarily dialectical and historical materialism, the philosophy of history and criticism of bourgeois philosophy.
